scope: Rejected isolated bounded immutable const captures in the compiler; no source integration, runtime/opcode extension, or full CLI speed claim.
disposition: Do not integrate the prototype: the actual native parse/check result is inconclusive at a 2% practical margin. Preserve source, all raw samples, and first failures.
candidateEligibility: Ordinary emission with functionsOut/reuse/environment absent; one explicit const with recursively literal scalar/table initializer; declaration-specific capture mode forwarded through parents. Mutable locals, helper functions, forward declarations, recursion, loop declarations, spills, patterns, ownership metadata and any potentially taken/borrowed names retain cells.
compatibility: functionsOut, reuse, and environment paths remain cellular; no serialized capture schema, bytecode opcode, native ABI, interim emitter case, pin, or seed changed. Table contents/identity may remain mutable because only the binding is constant.

correctness.nativeGcOracleInterleave: both native images pass with exact checksum

selfImage.note: Current source emitted by the first candidate compiler. Self2-to-self3 stability, broad suites and actual pinned fixpoint were deliberately deferred after the duration gate failed.

mechanism.interpretation: Static compiler code removes captured literal cells/loads, and exact native execution reaches the changed scanner/parser/checker modules. The key-read helper reduction is an observed counter delta; no exclusive CPU attribution or duration win follows from it.
mechanism.opcodeCounterGap: Frozen8a shared handlers reported ops executed0 despite successful interpreted work, even with NO_AOT/NO_THREADED. Dynamic GetCell frequency is unavailable here; zero is not a measured GetCell count.
mechanism.top16Caveat: Missing builtins from a top16 report are not zero.

workload.definition: Actual primary native compiler code parses/checks one frozen source with fresh memory-only environment per iteration; identical separately loaded interpreted loop driver. Wall duration includes process/image load, module initialization, environment creation, parsing, checking, GC, and checksum serialization. No repeated project file I/O. Not a whole CLI claim.
workload.driverInterpretation: The identical tiny loop/checksum driver is an additional image. Primary compiler bodies are AOT native; runtime validates the primary image hash against the linked object and checksums/entries are asserted in every process.

bootstrap.statistic: geometric mean of paired candidate/control wall ratios

measurement.outlierPolicy: Preserve every sample without filtering or retries.
measurement.context: Parent confirmed all helper CPU lanes idle before start; earlier cp/FSEvents/Spotlight activity settled. Unrelated system services were not modified. Host load and wait4 resources are preserved for every process.

preservedFailures.fixturePreparation: Original fixture correctly refused NUPP1002 because its declaration did not match the fixed component filename. Fixture2 correctly refused NUPP2002 because inferred table-field arithmetic returned number under an integer annotation. Fixture3 omits the declaration and consistently uses number annotations. Both failures and fixtures are preserved; no candidate source error.
preservedFailures.initialFocused: First focused attempt was terminated with empty output; subsequent failures were invalid scalar formatting/taking-const fixtures, corrected without changing checker semantics. All raw reports retained.
